crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:4d.title: Substation Engineer
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:4d.description: We understand that finding the right place to work isn't easy. At Beta Engineering, we believe in cultivating a team that wins together and takes on the most challenging projects in the high-voltage industry. We engineer, procure, and construct (EPC) projects for a variety of customers, including those in the utility, industrial, and renewable energy markets. Our work includes substations, transmission lines and more. We help our customers achieve their goals of creating a stronger power grid by reducing risks and identifying innovative solutions for their project challenges. Our Purpose: We pursue that which challenges us, growing our community to provide critical, creative solutions that achieve extraordinary results. Our Values: We do what we say, we turn challenges into success and we win together. Beta Engineering is currently looking for a Substation Engineer to join their team. Substation Engineers (SE) are responsible for the design, interpretation, application and documentation of drawings and calculations pertaining to the physical design of a substation. Substation Engineers are tasked with ensuring that designs, and their applications, are completed to code and standards set forth by the appropriate authoritative bodies. In addition, SE’s are required to work with customer representatives, Project Management Teams and other engineering disciplines to ensure designs meet appropriate specifications and requirements. BETA CORE COMPETENCIES: Understanding the value of the customer, Contributes to overall team success, Continuous and applied learning, Strategic development, and Pride CORE COMPETENCIES Customer Focus, Decision Quality, Business Insight, Drives Results, Collaborates, Communicates Effectively, Courage, Instills Trust, Manages Ambiguity ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Checks conduit, grounding, control shelter, electrical arrangements, outdoor lighting and equipment vendor design packages. Performs and checks grounding calculations. Performs and checks conduit fill calculations. Performs and checks pulling tension calculations. Performs and checks vehicle tracking calculations. Performs and checks outdoor lighting calculations. Performs and checks lightning protection designs calculations. Performs and checks substation Sag-10 calculations. Performs and checks flexible jumper calculations. Performs and checks bus design calculations. Performs and checks arc-flash calculations. Performs and checks insulation coordination calculations. Performs and checks underground ampacity calculations. Creates and checks material list descriptions for all major equipment. Creates and checks material list descriptions for all minor substation material. Demonstrates integrity and ethics in all client relationships and communications. Answers technical questions posed by construction managers, field staff, project managers, customers and their representatives. Recognize and recommend methods to improve customer’s experience. Perform other studies as able and required. Travels periodically to both customer offices for project meetings and to job sites for construction visits and testing Manages day-to-day activities of schedule and design of projects assigned to them Coordinates and problem solves between design teams and departments EXPECTATIONS: Performs quality work within deadlines with or without direct supervision. Interacts professionally with other employees and customers. Works effectively as a team contributor on all assigned projects. Communicates regularly with supervisor regarding designs, concerns, studies or tests Desire to participate in continued education and training Occasional overnight travel to active job sites Must have clean driving record as use of company vehicles is a requirement of position Adhere to and practice the Beta core competencies and Beta principle Maintains check print set of all work they perform Utilizes the department resources in an effective manner to get all work accomplishe

jobgether-jobgether:lever:5f9f7594-1502-.title: Channel Sales Director
jobgether-jobgether:lever:5f9f7594-1502-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Channel Sales Director based in Switzerland. As a Channel Sales Director, you will lead the expansion and growth of a strategic partner ecosystem across EMEA. You will own the channel go-to-market strategy, from identifying and recruiting partners to enabling them and driving sustainable indirect revenue. The role combines senior commercial leadership with enough technical depth to engage credibly around software, hardware, architecture, APIs, and integrations. You will build executive-level relationships, shape joint business plans, and collaborate closely with direct sales, product, engineering, and solutions teams. Your work will directly influence market expansion, pipeline generation, customer outcomes, and overall commercial growth. This is a remote, internationally focused opportunity with significant travel across Europe. Lead the EMEA channel strategy: Define and execute a comprehensive channel go-to-market strategy aligned with commercial objectives and regional growth opportunities. Build the partner ecosystem: Identify, recruit, onboard, and develop strategic partners capable of expanding market reach and delivering strong customer outcomes. Own partner relationships: Establish trusted, executive-level relationships and manage the full partner lifecycle, from initial engagement through long-term growth. Drive indirect revenue: Develop joint business plans, co-selling motions, pipeline-generation initiatives, and other programs that translate partner relationships into measurable revenue. Enable partners technically: Ensure partners have the knowledge, resources, and capabilities required to position, demonstrate, implement, and support solutions effectively. Develop partner programs: Design incentives, enablement initiatives, certification programs, and co-marketing activities that increase partner engagement and commercial performance. Coordinate with direct sales: Align channel and direct sales activity, establish clear territory strategies, and proactively resolve potential channel conflicts. Influence business strategy: Bring partner feedback, customer insights, and market intelligence into product, engineering, and broader business strategy discussions. Measure channel performance: Track revenue, pipeline, partner acquisition, technical certification, satisfaction, and program ROI to identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Collaborate across functions: Work closely with product, engineering, solutions, and commercial teams to ensure channel initiatives are technically sound and commercially effective. Requirements: Channel leadership experience: 10+ years of experience in channel, partner, or indirect sales, ideally within technology, manufacturing, distribution, software, SaaS, or hardware environments. Partner ecosystem expertise: Demonstrated success building, scaling, and managing partner ecosystems that generate meaningful revenue and market growth. Commercial leadership: Experience leading teams or cross-functional channel functions spanning both commercial and technical responsibilities. Technical understanding: Comfortable discussing product architecture, APIs, integrations, and technical concepts at a high level with partners and internal stakeholders. Strategic thinking: Strong strategic and analytical capabilities, with the ability to translate market opportunities and partner data into actionable commercial plans. Relationship building: Excellent executive communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills. Customer and market orientation: Ability to understand partner and customer needs and turn market insights into effective channel strategies. Industry experience: Experience selling to departments of transportation or their technology and service vendors would be advantageous. Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Engin

southparkcommons-rox-ai:ashbyhq:31fda8e9.title: Strategic Account Executive (Austin)
southparkcommons-rox-ai:ashbyhq:31fda8e9.description: ABOUT US At Rox https://rox.com/, we believe in empowering people to do their best work. Our platform supercharges sellers with autonomous revenue agents to do the manual work so they can focus on what they do best: selling. Just as coding agents 10x’d engineering, revenue agents 10x customer work. We are reimagining the revenue stack by building the world’s first revenue operating system, from the application layer to the system of context. With Rox, humans are evolving to orchestrators while agents manage the end-to-end customer lifecycle. Rox powers Global 2000 leaders in banking, hardware, construction, and sovereign AI, while serving dominant AI winners like Ramp and Cognition. Underlying all of this success is a unwavering, shared belief in the mission, with an unreasonable commitment of doing whatever it takes to make it a reality. THE TEAM Nothing is possible without the world-class team, assembled to redefine how businesses operate. Members on our team have: - Founded and exited successful companies - Held the highest positions at Google, AWS, Confluent, and New Relic - Won IMO and IOI gold medals - Published field-defining papers We’re backed by the best, having raised $50M from Sequoia (Alfred Lin), General Catalyst (Hemant Taneja), Google Ventures, Elad Gil, and Chris Ré. CORE PRINCIPLES TASTE: CRAFT BEAUTIFUL EXPERIENCES. No matter how small, we strive to make sure every detail is right. We care deeply about every interaction, both in terms of whether it helps the seller get the job done, but also how the product makes them feel. We get a visceral feeling when something is off and stop at nothing to make sure we make it right. We never settle, continuously exploring ways to delight sellers. OBSESSION: COMMIT UNREASONABLY. In all aspects of our craft, we commit. We not only are immediately reactive to customers’ requests but are proactive about driving value even before they ask. We are also obsessive about always learning and honing our craft, improving ourselves and product every single day. ACTION: GET IT DONE. Talking is easy but the difference comes from the execution. We lean heavily towards making thoughtful yet fast decisions and delivering immediately. We play in a field where trust is paramount. We earn the trust and right to empower the best sellers by forging a history of over-delivering on the promise at record speed. YOUR ROLE As a Strategic Account Executive at Rox, you’ll be responsible for bringing the world’s best revenue teams into the age of AI. You’ll lead highly consultative, value-driven sales cycles with C-level decision-makers at fast-growing startups and established enterprises. Every deal will be different — no playbooks, no scripts — just first principles thinking, deep technical curiosity, and a relentless drive to understand the customer’s pain and map Rox’s capabilities to their workflows. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, and wants to help define how AI-native platforms are sold and adopted. You’ll work closely with product, solutions, and leadership to continuously evolve our go-to-market motion, all while building long-term relationships with some of the most forward-thinking GTM teams in the world. If you’re a high-agency seller with a technical edge and a builder’s mindset, we’d love to talk. RESPONSIBILITIES - Own the full sales cycle: from qualification to negotiation to close - Develop deep understanding of each prospect’s revenue workflows and pain points - Lead tailored product demos and build compelling value narratives - Collaborate with product and solutions teams to shape roadmap and integrations - Continuously refine messaging and materials based on what resonates in the field - Help shape the GTM engine at Rox — from process to tooling to playbooks - Represent Rox with clarity, energy, and urgency in every interaction QUALIFICATIONS - 4+ years of strategic sales experience closing deals in the $100K–2M+ range - Sold to enterprise buye
